programme.desc: Luma Simms grew up in a Christian family in Iraq. For her as a child, Christianity was very much a cultural identity, tied also to her experience of the Orthodox Faith. When her family left Iraq before coming to the US, they encountered Evangelical missionaries who told them they were not "real” Christians yet, and that they had to adopt Evangelicalism. Along the way, Luma began to gravitate toward a more Calvinist expression of Christianity. But when that theology began to unravel, she started to look deeper into historical theology, finding that her true Christian home was in the Catholic Church, which she entered in 2018.

programme.desc: Luma Simms grew up in a Christian family in Iraq. For her as a child, Christianity was very much a cultural identity, tied also to her experience of the Orthodox Faith. When her family left Iraq before coming to the US, they encountered Evangelical missionaries who told them they were not "real” Christians yet, and that they had to adopt Evangelicalism. Along the way, Luma began to gravitate toward a more Calvinist expression of Christianity. But when that theology began to unravel, she started to look deeper into historical theology, finding that her true Christian home was in the Catholic Church, which she entered in 2018.

programme.title: Pakistan : Liberté Pour Tous Les Captifs
programme.desc: Aux captifs la liberté, une expression d’Isaïe chapitre 61, résume l'essence du travail pastoral du père Tomas. Tout en s'occupant des besoins spirituels des membres des tribus du Sind, il leur apprend qu'ils sont des enfants de Dieu avec la plus grande dignité et non les scories du système de castes. En même temps, il aide des familles à briser les liens du travail en servitude qui nie leurs droits d'êtres humains les plus élémentaires. Le père Tomas s'occupe des besoins spirituels des personnes qui ont embrassé la foi chrétienne dans cette région du sud du Pakistan, un pays à majorité musulmane, mais avec de fortes traces du système de castes hindou. La plupart des chrétiens convertis viennent de plus bas sous-groupes du système millénaire des castes de l'Inde, ce qui en fait des cibles faciles pour l’exploitation et les abus.

programme.title: Journey Home
programme.sub-title: Luma Simms - Former Orthodox and Evangelical
programme.desc: Luma Simms grew up in a Christian family in Iraq. For her as a child, Christianity was very much a cultural identity, tied also to her experience of the Orthodox Faith. When her family left Iraq before coming to the US, they encountered Evangelical missionaries who told them they were not "real” Christians yet, and that they had to adopt Evangelicalism. Along the way, Luma began to gravitate toward a more Calvinist expression of Christianity. But when that theology began to unravel, she started to look deeper into historical theology, finding that her true Christian home was in the Catholic Church, which she entered in 2018.

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.title: Tertulias de fe
programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. Además de su labor en las parroquias, ayudó a fundar en 2011 el capítulo en español del movimiento católico Magnificat con la aprobación del obispo de la región.

programme.title: Siervo de todos
programme.desc: En un tiempo en el que la voz del Señor parece ahogada por «otras voces» y la propuesta de seguirlo entregando la propia vida puede parecer un absurdo, Dios sigue llamando a quien quiere, otorgando a través del Sacramento del Orden, la misión de servir en nombre y representación de Cristo-Cabeza en medio de la comunidad. A toda la Iglesia le urge responder a esta llamada.

programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. Además responde a las preguntas llegadas al programa vía telefónica, el correo electrónico (padrepedro@ewtn.com) y Facebook (www.facebook.com/ppedronunez).

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

Para ello se basa en la Exhortación Apostólica “Gaudate Et Exsultate” del Papa Francisco que nos hace un llamado a la Santidad. “Todos estamos llamados a ser santos viviendo con amor y ofreciendo el propio testimonio en las ocupaciones de cada día, allí donde cada uno se encuentra'', Francisco.

programme.title: Tertulias de fe
programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. Además de su labor en las parroquias, ayudó a fundar en 2011 el capítulo en español del movimiento católico Magnificat con la aprobación del obispo de la región.

programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. Además responde a las preguntas llegadas al programa vía telefónica, el correo electrónico (padrepedro@ewtn.com) y Facebook (www.facebook.com/ppedronunez).

programme.title: Perspectiva Católica
programme.desc: En una época en la que la bandera de la libertad parece flamear casi en todas partes, se dan cada vez más y más atropellos en contra de la libertad de vivencia y profesión de la fe. Magdalena Lira, directora nacional de ACN (Ayuda a la Iglesia que sufre) en Chile, nos ofrece un panorama de la situación en el país, que se encuentra en observación en materia de libertad religiosa.

programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. Isaac's name, meaning "laughter," symbolizes that nothing is impossible with God, and his near-sacrifice foreshadows the sacrifice of the Messiah. Jacob's encounter with the stone prophecy reveals the manifestation of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. These interconnected tales point to the ultimate Messiah.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Dave Stotts open in Jerusalem and discuss the impact of Jesus over the last 2,000 years. He presents the set-up for the arrival of Jesus in the context of Jewish and Roman history. He travel to Nazareth and present the four different Gospel writers, Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John and learns the importance of genealogies as they related to a promised Jewish Messiah.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Miracle of the Annunciation
programme.desc: Dave Stotts stays in Nazareth and investigates the Annunciation, where the Angel Gabriel delivered very special news to a virgin girl named Mary. He explore the concepts of angels, miracles, and the importance of the Virgin Birth. He discusses the Roman census and the trip by Joseph and Mary to Bethlehem and examines the importance of Bethlehem in the ancient prophecies about a coming Messiah.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Dave Stotts visit the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem and takes a look at the accounts of Jesus’ birth. He examines the birthplace of Jesus and the accounts of shepherds in the fields nearby. He explores the journey of the "Wise Men" from the East, known as Magi, and the Star of Bethlehem that summoned them. Dave Stotts then investigates the date for Jesus’ birth and the importance of Christmas traditions throughout the centuries.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Grows Up During the Reign of King Herod
programme.desc: Dave Stotts delve into the world of Herod the Great at the time of Jesus’ birth. He examines the “slaughter of the innocents” in Judea. He then visits a number of awesome archaeological sites in Israel built by Herod, including the massive Herodium about seven miles south of Jerusalem. He learn about the escape of Joseph, Mary and Jesus to Egypt until Herod’s death and travels to Jesus’ hometown of Nazareth where he later grew up.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: John the Baptist and the Start of Jesus' Ministry
programme.desc: Dave Stotts starts with the world of Jesus’ youth after the death of Herod the Great. He delves into the Roman occupation and its impact on the Jewish people and learns about John the Baptizer and his ministry of repentance in the wilderness. We experience the baptism of Jesus at the Jordan River and his testing in the Judean desert shortly thereafter.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Returns to Galilee
programme.desc: Dave Stotts explores the Sea of Galilee where Jesus begins his active ministry and gathers his first disciples Peter, Andrew, James and John.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Turns Water to Wine and Confronts Legalism
programme.desc: Dave Stott visit Chorazin, another location in Jesus’ ministry. He examine Cana and the first miracle performed by Jesus at the wedding in Cana, Jesus turns water to wine, astounding the guests. He follow Jesus to Jerusalem, where Jesus occasionally travelled during special Jewish festivals. He gets angry at the treatment of the temple in Jerusalem and he confronts the religious elites. Jesus meets a Pharisee named Nicodemus and delivers a very special message about eternal life.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Teachings Change Lives
programme.desc: Dave Stotts travel to Samaria and learn about the history of the Samaritans. He learns the story of the Samaritan woman at the well. He again travel to Jerusalem and investigate two pools where Jesus performed special miracles and learns that Jesus brings Living Water. We hear Jesus proclaim himself as the Light of the World.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Sermon on the Mount
programme.desc: Dave Stotts visit the hillsides of Galilee and hear Jesus deliver the Sermon on the Mount. He walk the Mount of the Beatitudes and explore many of Jesus’ radically new teachings. He learn about salted fish at Magdala and Roman roads at Hippos and delves into Jesus' use of parables, including many of the most famous delivered by Jesus during his ministry.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Travels the Sea of Galilee
programme.desc: Jesus chose twelve apostles from his group of followers. Spend time on the Sea of Galilee and see Jesus calm the waves as he traveled the ancient harbors.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Travel to Caesarea Philippi where Jesus started to wrap-up his public ministry. Also, witness a mountaintop miracle known as the Transfiguration.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Extraordinary Life of Jesus of Nazareth
programme.desc: On his way to Jerusalem, Jesus spent time with children and confronted a rich young ruler. Visit Bethany and experience the raising of Lazarus from the dead.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Arrives in Jerusalem
programme.desc: Jesus visited Jericho on his final approach to Jerusalem. Experience the accounts of Bartimaeus, the blind beggar, and Zacchaeus, the tax collector.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Jesus and his disciples leave the temple complex and discuss the destruction of the temple. Jesus predicts the terrible events that will take place, including his own betrayal and crucifixion.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Trial of Jesus
programme.desc: See the the events that led up to the trial of Jesus. He prayed in the Garden of Gethsemane, He was betrayed by Judas and arrested by the Jewish authorities.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Crucifixion Of Jesus
programme.desc: Experience the horrible torture of Jesus and his agonizing execution just outside the walls of Jerusalem and examine the nature of crucifixion and the importance of Jesus’ death.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Resurrection of Jesus
programme.desc: Share in the excitement of an empty tomb three days after Jesus’ death, visiting Jerusalem to investigate the accounts of the Resurrection. Explore the Jewish and Roman responses to such a miraculous event.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: We finish with the four faces of the Gospels, the different biographical perspectives on the life of Jesus. We reexamine the Messianic prophecies and visit Qumran in the context of the Dead Sea Scrolls. What is the legacy of Jesus’ followers? What is the summary of the “Good News” of the Gospel accounts? programme.desc: Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: France & Marc’s home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Susan’s energetic son, Harrison, has no space to dance at home without getting under his mom’s feet. Brian and Sarah build a hang out / dance space for Harrison and create a California-inspired pool and lounge area for Susan.

programme.title: Backyard Builds

programme.title: Backyard Builds

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Janet’s love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Steve and Tanya are Realtors who just bought their forever home a few doors down from Tanya’s parents. To complete their dream home, Brian and Sarah build a dream cottage retreat in their backyard.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Marlow, Phil, their 3 small kids, and Phil’s parents all live in one crowded house. Brian and Sarah transform their yard into a spectacular space for cooking, entertaining and playing.

programme.title: Backyard Builds

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

programme.title: Backyard Builds

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig’s brother, Craig’s parents – and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

programme.title: Backyard Builds

programme.desc: Soon to be married Renee and Tasos are embarrassed about their neglected backyard. Brian and Sarah make their yard honeymoon ready, with a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

programme.desc: This week on American Trends & Lifestyle, our new host Lauren Makk gets into the Halloween spirit with a look at Orlando’s seasonal fun and steps into the magical world of Willy Wonka. Plus, Trans-Siberian Orchestra celebrates 30 years of rocking the holidays, author Nathan Moris shares tips for meaningful life changes, and we go behind the scenes of the adventure thriller Heart of the Beast. We’ll also share important information to help those living with asthma better understand and manage their condition.

programme.title: Coffee with America Episode 639
programme.desc: This week on an all-new episode of Coffee with America, host Sasha Rionda celebrates fall with a coastal California getaway and smart strategies for navigating the season’s biggest sales. We’ll also travel to Costa Rica for a luxurious escape inspired by coffee traditions and head to Hong Kong for a colorful look at its Mid-Autumn Festival celebrations.

programme.title: YETI Climbing National Championships 2026 - Lead Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The USA Climbing 2026 National Championships for Youth (YETI Nationals) at High Point Climbing and Fitness in Orlando, FL, bringing together top young climbers for Boulder, Lead, and Speed events to crown national champions and select athletes for national teams, showcasing Florida's competitive climbing scene.

programme.title: Paddy'O Sucks at Climbing
programme.desc: PaddyO doesnt just suck at climbinghe actively dislikes it, insisting s a fear-based sport where the fun never shows up. Can national climbing champ Kai Lightner change his mind? Will PaddyOs dislike of sucking beat his dislike of being scared? Can he get his massive hooves into climbing shoes without crying like a baby? Great questions!

programme.title: Episode 10, Weekend Whipper — A 15-Foot Ground Fall
programme.desc: On this episode of Weekend Whipper, belayer Matt Gowie is traumatized when climber Luis Armando takes a a 15-foot fall, all the way to the ground. The route is 'Partners in Crime', a 5.11a trad climb in Squamish, British Columbia. On the ground, the climbing partners react to the crazy fall.

programme.title: Episode 8 | Weekend Whipper | Upside-Down in South Africa
programme.desc: In this episode of Weekend Whipper, climber Greg Wright takes a giant whip on "Explorer" (24/5.11c) at Slanghoek Amphitheatre in Western Cape, South Africa, in which he flips fully upside-down.

programme.title: Climbings Newest Hotbed
programme.desc: Sasha travels to Manikia, a small village in Greece, to experience an emerging climbing destination. Manikia has only recently come into the spotlight as a potential world-class climbing destination. Sasha is joined on this adventure by fellow climbers from the Petzl team. The ultimate goal is to help establish a new climbing area the right way. During this trip, Sasha and the team set new routes in calibration with local climbers and guides while discussing ecotourism's positive and negative effects on local communities.

programme.title: Precision Footwork: Technique and Drills CLIMB Ep 9 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Learn to power your movement starting with your feet in order to climb to new heights. In this episode, pro climber Paige Claassen takes you through advanced moves and some drills to help up your footwork game.

programme.title: Ashtanga Yoga
programme.desc: Sasha finally gets the opportunity to learn more about ashtanga yoga and shares her new favorite recipe for maca bars.

programme.title: What is Lobbying? Climb the Hill with DiGiulian, Honnold, and Caldwell
programme.desc: Sasha, Alex Honnold, and Tommy Caldwell climb capitol hill and talk outdoor access in DC.

programme.title: The Trilogy
programme.desc: On July 12, 2018, professional climber, Sasha DiGiulian, set out to become the first woman and second person in history to complete the Rocky Mountain Trilogy, a compilation of three of the hardest 5.14 big walls in the Canadian Rockies. The imposing climbs, on Castle Mountain, Mount Louis, and Mount Yamnuska, respectively will take Sasha 2 months of continued effort with the ultimate goal of ascending each sheer wall in a single day push, with zero falls — a combined average of over 9,000 vertical feet of climbing at a lung-busting average elevation of 7,000ft. Setbacks with climbing partners, a shoulder injury, and mounting wildfires, DiGiulian is faced with ever-increasing obstacles and forced to balance her goals with her safety. This is not only an extraordinarily unique physical journey, but a universal introspective story of overcoming fear, the importance of self-confidence, and finding friends when and where you least expect them. Pushing through the uncomfortable moments and riding the ups and downs of life, DiGiulian drives herself through mounting fatigue and a closing weather window to strive for her historical goal.

programme.title: One-Legged Injury Training in Boulder, CO
programme.desc: A nagging injury means Sasha is in a walking boot, but doesnt let that stop her training. Physical Therapist Josslyn works through rehab training.

programme.title: There Are More Urban Climbing Areas Than You Think
programme.desc: Kush Khandelwal, Climbing contributor, highlights some little-known crags near major cities in states including Ohio, Minnesota, Virginia, and Illinois. Crags near urban areas help people get climbing after work. Talking head with burned-in captions and minimal stock imagery of the locations.

programme.title: The Golden Pitons Return
programme.desc: Kitty Calhoun, Alpinist and Activist, Tommy Caldwell, Former Golden Piton Winner and Pro Climber, Kai Lightner, Pro Climber and Founder of Climbing for Change, Beth Rodden, Former Golden Piton Winner and Pro Climber, and Mason Earle, Former Golden Piton Winner and Former Pro Climber, help re-launch the Golden Piton Awards for Climbing Mag, telling people to vote by January 31st.

programme.title: Master Dynamic Movement CLIMB Ep 10 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Learn how to tackle boulder problems and routes with explosive, dynamic power, and transform your climbing. In this episode, pro climber Carlo Traversi teaches you how to use your energy and momentum to send your next climb.

programme.title: Paige Claassen's Two-Shoe Tip
programme.desc: A professional climber Paige Claassen does a two-shoe tip on the bouldering problem 'Trice', a v12 in Flagstaff, Arizona.

programme.title: Field Tested: The North Face Advanced Mountain Kit
programme.desc: Climbing Senior Editor Anthony Walsh reviews the new Advanced Mountain Kit by The North Face. The kit includes some useful pieces, and some that are poorly design. Anthony covers the pros and cons of five pieces from the Summit Series Advanced Mountain Kit: its 40L Pack, VENTRIX Crop Pants, Vest, Verto FA Boots, and FUTURELIGHT Climb Pants. Direct-to-camera gear review with original product and field b roll.

programme.title: Yoga for Climbers: Yoga for Better Alignment and Power CLIMB 23 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Whether you're a veteran big waller, casual gym climber, or just getting started, doing yoga will help you send. In this episode, pro climber and yoga instructor Heidi Wirtz will help better align your shoulders and strengthen your core.

programme.title: Yoga for Climbers: Yoga to Help You Send CLIMB 30 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Whether you're a veteran big waller, casual gym climber, or just getting started, doing yoga will help you send. In this episode, pro climber and yoga instructor Heidi Wirtz takes you through various yoga flows to help improve your climbing.

programme.title: Cowboy Country
programme.desc: Deep in cowboy country, pro climber Alex Honnold joins endurance runner Peyton Thomas for an unexpected adventure in the Ruby Mountains. Off the trail, he dives into Basque culture, cowboy poetry, and silversmiths, a romantic gift for his wife.

programme.title: USA Climbing Season-End Highlights: Speed and Lead Results
programme.desc: Climbing Editor-in-Chief Maya Silver reports on the last USA Climbing event of the year, which took place in downtown Salt Lake City from August 22nd to the 24th. Highlights from the speed climbing and lead climbing events included local Natalia Grossman making a gold-winning comeback after a knee surgery six months ago and Sergey Lakhno getting gold in the men's lead competition, as one of only two competitors to top the route. Michaela Kirsch, Kai Lightner, and Nathaniel Coleman all did well, but Kirsch placed fourth and Kai and Nathaniel didn't make a place in the finals.

programme.title: 2026 UIAA World Cup | Lead Finals
programme.desc: The UIAA Ice Climbing World Cup finals in Longmont, Colorado, are an annual winter event hosted at the Longmont Climbing Collective, featuring elite athletes competing in speed and lead climbing for world titles.

programme.title: Mind Body Connection with Gabby Reece and Laird Hamilton
programme.desc: Sasha journeys to Malibu, CA, to meet up with professional athletes turned entrepreneurs Laird Hamilton and Gabby Reece. After an intense morning XPT training session for the body and mind, Sasha sits down to hear more about Lairds Superfood, a business born after Laird started adding different plant-based fats to his morning coffee. Laird and Gabbys emphasis on sustainability and social responsibility in all their product choices is an example every business should follow.

programme.title: Training and Meetings
programme.desc: Sasha DiGiulian wakes up in New York City for a day of meetings, interviews, and an event for the Right To Play Nonprofit.

programme.title: Sasha DiGiulian and Marianna Ordóñez Climb Madagascar’s ‘Bravo Les Filles'
programme.desc: Over a remote video recording, pro climbers Sasha DiGiulian and Marianna “Mango” Ordóñez talk about their climb of 'Bravo Les Filles' (5.13d/8b; 600 meters; 13 pitches) in Tsaranoro Valley, Madagascar, following in the footsteps of climbing icon Lynn Hill, the first ascensionist of the route. Run-and-gun B-roll, captured by the climbing partners, sets the scene. Sasha and Mango discuss the surprising risk associated with the state of the route and how they tackled the project anyway. They touch on Lynn's inspiration and their own intended inspiration, on the global female climbing community. Read the full story here: https://www.climbing.com/news/sasha-digiulian-and-marianna-ordonez-pick-up-where-lynn-hill-left-off-in-madagascar/

programme.title: A Climbers Paradise
programme.desc: Sasha travels to the remote island of Makatea in French Polynesia to learn about the island's unique history and see how establishing a world-class climbing destination could help create a new local economy. For years, phosphates mining took the rock away from this once pristine island. The remaining scars are a vivid reminder of the island's former destructive economy. Sasha and local climbers discuss how increased adventure tourism specific to climbing might help revitalize the local economy and deter a return to mining that is once again being considered.

programme.title: Essential Self-Rescue for Climbers: Ascending CLIMB 17 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Learn basic self-rescue skills and how to think critically in a climbing emergency. In this episode, guide and search-and-rescue pro, Karsten Delap teaches you how to ascend with different devices and use mechanical advantage to raise a load.

programme.title: Gear Review: Edelrid Ohmega
programme.desc: Text popups and b roll footage show off key elements of the Edelrid Ohmega, a new belay assistant for climbing partners with big weight differences.

programme.title: Digging Deeper
programme.desc: Pro climber Alex Honnold heads to one of Nevada's spookiest towns. In Tonopah, he hunts for ghosts, digs for gems, checks into a haunted hotel, and reunites with Caldwell for a high-alpine climb up Mt. Jefferson.

programme.title: Bolting and Developing in Breaks Interstate, VA
programme.desc: Development is a big part of climbing and Sasha talks about the dos and donts of developing and bolting.

programme.title: 2023 YETI National Championships: Lead Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: 2023 YETI Climbing National Championships: Lead Semi-Finals. The 2023 YETI Climbing National Championships takes place in Boise, Idaho, and will bring many of America’s best competitive climbers together, including Olympic and National Team members, and will provide a first look at some of the athletes that will be working their way toward the top of the climbing rankings.

programme.title: Climbing Guide Books vs. Apps
programme.desc: Climbing Contributor, Gavin Feek, discusses his article about climbing guide books and their future alongside newer climbing apps, as well as the rise of AI. He describes the ethical concerns related to new digital climbing guides compared to their older counterparts.

programme.title: Debunking Bio Plastics
programme.desc: Sasha travels to Maine where she meets up with local climber Erin OToole and Marine Research Scientist Abby Barrows who are doing their part in areas of sustainability and conservation. Sasha sees firsthand how businesses and individuals can work to make Maine and our world a better place.

programme.title: How to Transfer a Belay
programme.desc: Silas Rossi, IFMGA/AMGA Mountain Guide, walks through the steps to transfer a belay. First, ensure the climber is in a secure position and not hanging on the rope. Next, tie a clove hitch in the brake hand side of the rope and attach it to your belay loop with a locking carabiner. Next, transfer the belay device to the belay loop of the new belayer. Once you’ve checked it, untie the clove hitch and proceed with belaying.

programme.title: What to Look for When Buying Quickdraws
programme.desc: Professional climber, climbing guide, and Climbing contributor Genevive Walker covers what to look for when buying quickdraws. She covers quickdraw shape options (D-shaped and asymmetrical), solid gates v. wire gates, length, and alpine draws and anchor draws. She recommends you check your dogbone and carabiners for wear and tear, and know when it's time to retire them. Talking head show-and-tell with the different kids of draws.

programme.title: The Unexpected Ways this Dirtbag Fund Grant Recipient Used his Funding
programme.desc: Emilio Taiveaho, a climber from North Carolina and a recipient of the Dirtbag Fund grant, shares reflections from his experiences pre- and post-winning the Dirtbag Fund. While he didn't spend the funds exactly how he had anticipated, he was stoked to be part of the first round of fund recipients, and his stoke is still high.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes on "The Sound"
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes film about the making of "The Sound", a 2025 survival horror film about a group of climbers embarking on a dangerous climb that has been off-limits for years.

programme.title: Multi-Pitch Route
programme.desc: Sasha heads to Eldorado Canyon with Laura Capps to climb the multi-pitch route Vertigo. She discovers the practical functionality of Vapur water bottles and then grabs lunch at Zeal food in Boulder.

programme.title: 30-Foot Fall from a Broken Hold: Weekend Whipper, Episode 14
programme.desc: In this episode of Weekend Whipper, Climber Noah Kane falls 30 feet after a hold breaks the 5th pitch of El Sendero Luminoso in El Portrero Chico Mexico. UGC footage with graphics.

programme.title: The Valley Boy: The Story of Grant Cline
programme.desc: Climbing Contributor Gavin Feek reports on the late Gavin Cline, an 18-year-old who sadly passed away [Grant fell to his death in an accident at Royal Arches]. Grant was a prominent member of the Yosemite climbing community, living in employee housing within the park and working at the Lodge. Gavin nods to the fuller story in his article and shares imagery of Grant, his loved ones, and his living quarters in Yosemite National Park.

programme.title: Indigenous Ice Climbers: The Cholitas of Bolivia
programme.desc: Minidoc about the strides of the Cholitas Escaladoras, a group of female, Indigenous ice climbers in Bolivia which was founded in 2015. Cholitas leader and co-founder Cecilia Llusco shares the successes the women have had in increasing visibility for the Indigenous Aymara women of Bolivia, who have faced femicide and discrimination, by summiting large mountains "en pollera" (wearing traditional skirts and clothing). Cecilia's big dream is to summit Mount Everest. Follow Cecilia and a fellow Cholita as they climb Huayna Potosí, a 6,088-meter peak near El Alto, Bolivia. This peak inspired Cecilia's mission as a young girl.

programme.title: Choosing a Personal Anchor System
programme.desc: Silas Rossi, IFMGA/AMGA Mountain Guide and owner of Alpine Logic, discusses different personal anchors (also known as personal tethers or abbreviated as PAS). He recommends the Petzl Dual Connect Adjust, as well as the Petzl Connect Adjust as options, and also demonstrates the Metolius Personal Anchor System, and the Kong SLYDE as a more economical option. He also explains pros and cons of creating a personal anchor with a cordalette or a 4-foot runner or sling. Read the full story at www.climbing.com/gear/no-one-size-fits-all-personal-anchor

programme.title: Climbing in Moab
programme.desc: Sasha DiGiulian wakes up in Moab and gets a morning crack climb in, then cruises back to Denver for an afternoon training session with Dave Wahl at Movement Climbing Gym.

Join us to cheer for Team USA and the world’s best competition climbers as IFSC World Cups return to Salt Lake City. programme.title: How to Paint Bolts
programme.desc: Bolt painting lesson with Evan Wisheropp, a route developer, professional climber, and photographer. On the route 'Shark Bait', a 5.12c in California, Evan demonstrates how he camouflages bolts and their surrounding, often garish paint with the help of rock-matching paint and chalk, giving lots of tips and takeaways. Then he climbs the route he has freshly painted!

programme.title: Episode 13, Weekend Whipper - The Triple Ripper
programme.desc: Michael Scarborough is nearly at the top of “Gettin’ Schooled,” a 5.12c finger crack by Evan Wisheropp in Long Canyon, when he falls, ripping out three microcams from the sandstone. A yellow Black Diamond nut catches his fall in this week’s Weekend Whipper.

programme.title: Sending a 5.14c Just Over 4 Months After Giving Birth
programme.desc: Jenya Kazbekova, Ukrainian Pro Climber & Former Olympian, discusses her send on Necessary Evil, a 5.14c/8c+ sport route in Arizona’s Virgin River Gorge. Jenya’s daughter Taisiia was born in August 2025, and she climbed throughout the pregnancy, and got right back to the sport afterwards as well. Jenya took just five sessions to redpoint Necessary Evil before sending it, her second 8c+ route. Her first, The Güllich, is in Russian annexed Crimea. Jenya is looking forward to representing Ukraine at the Olympics in 2028 and hopes to be able to go back to her country soon.

programme.title: How Mary Eden Became the Crack Queen

As winter arrives in the burned forest, so do the skiers. They have come to celebrate new lines opened up by the previous summer's fires that have now burned themselves out -- or have they?

programme.title: Quarter Past Midnight | Salomon TV

Kaj Zackrisson, Mark Abma, and Mike Douglas discover it also serves as a fine stepping-off point to some of the best, undiscovered heliskiing on the planet.

programme.title: Intrinsic - Chris Sharma

programme.title: Season Pass | Trailer
programme.desc: Warren Miller Entertainment brings their best work to the small screen. These are the undisputed, best ski movies from the Warren Miller film vault. programme.title: Mick Fanning

programme.title: Ice - presented by The Ouray Ice Park

programme.title: Crankworx Christchurch Downhill

This year’s festival isn’t just for the pros—it will provide a chance for local up-and-coming riders to race alongside national and global heroes on two purpose-built courses. Whether competing in local, regional, or national races, male or female, this festival will offer a platform for progression and a shot at stepping into the spotlight on a regional, national level.

programme.desc: The Vegan Cyclist and Jeremiah Bishop are challenged by Tour Divide winner and winter biking specialist; Jay Petervary. Jays winter hell route is extreme Fat Biking. Will these two winter beginners remember what they learned from their winter survival course? Will they make it through the sub-zero wilderness?

Harsh conditions, injuries, and crashes are all part of mountain biking but can Jackson show what he can do before the end of the season? Or is he going to run out of time before he gets up to speed?

After being greeted by the hosts and judges, the contestants have presented their custom painted 2022 Orbea Rallon; specd go out by our sponsors. The athletes first challenge? To display their mechanical prowess by fixing a litany of unknown mechanical problems on their bikes, all while racing against the clock. Who will gain an early advantage, and who will fall behind in the first episode of Pinkbike Academy Season 3?

This year, athletes will battle for crucial points in the King and Queen of Crankworx standings while fans cheer on their favourites in Rotorua’s unique, family-friendly atmosphere.

programme.title: Tour de Gravel

By riding across the Pyrenees from Bayonne - Luchon- Perpignan. Begging the question: is it possible to recreate the experience, finish in the time cut.

programme.title: North of Nightfall
programme.desc: Hidden among the glaciers on Axel Heiberg Island, high in the Arctic Circle, are mountain bike lines too incredible to ignore. Harsh temperatures, volatile weather and nine-month winters mean the area is normally devoid of human life. But each summer, this frozen landscape flourishes under endless daylight revealing a spectacular ecosystem. Join Darren Berrecloth, Carson Storch, Cam Zink and Tom van Steenbergen in North of Nightfall as they embark on an expedition to the top of the world to explore this relatively unknown land. Here they discover a rapidly changing environment steeped in history along with descents unlike anything anyone’s ridden to date.

programme.title: The Scavenger Hunt Challenge

After the Pinkbike team has thrown every challenge possible at them, they have been whittled down to four remaining contestants. These four will compete in the final race for the grand prize: $30,000 and a pro mountain biking contract. Today is race day.

programme.title: Diamondback Sync'r Review: Sync or Swim? | 2022 Pinkbike Value Field Test

programme.desc: Welcome back to the Pinkbike Weekly Show. Sarah Moore joins today’s show and we chat about our tips for surviving the muddy conditions while riding. Henry and Mike team up for a 2 Min of Tech segment from their video comparing the new Fox 38 and RockShox Zeb forks. We then discuss the latest Recreational Wrecks and what $1000 can buy you on the Pinkbike Buy and Sell. There’s loads of racing coming up from Val di Sole World Cups and Crankworx Innsbruck so stay glued to the homepage this weekend!

programme.title: Crankworx Specialized Canadian Open Downhill
programme.desc: Straight down, no mercy, watched by downhill fans around the world. The Canadian Open DH is a one-run showdown on Whistler's rooty, technical single-track — a course that separates the fast from the fearless. Elite riders from across the globe line up alongside hungry up-and-comers and amateurs, all chasing the same clock. Tune in and watch some of the world's fastest riders on the planet send it straight to the bottom.

programme.title: Crankworx Rhapsody Slopestyle
programme.desc: Staged in the “Boneyard,” the dirt stadium at the base of the Whistler Mountain Bike Park, Rhapsody Slopestyle offers the best Slopestyle mountain bikers on the planet two runs – that’s two chances for glory, two opportunities to throw down high-scoring tricks and move up the leader board, and two moments in time to leave their mark on the history of the sport. The 18 best riders in the world bring their A-game to this invitational showcase, interpreting a custom-built course and giving it their all.

programme.title: Crankworx Mont-Sainte-Anne Downhill
programme.desc: Watch the world's top riders compete on this legendary downhill track in the inaugural Crankworx Mont-Sainte-Anne festival. This world-famous race is the final stop of the 2026 Crankworx Downhill series and will test riders in the ultimate battle of speed, technique, and courage. The track features a steep, long and demanding descent, dotted with rocks, roots and impressive jumps, all in front of a roaring crowd of MTB fans.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Cold Fusion (2001)
programme.desc: Pack your bags and come along as skiers and riders like Chris Anthony, Rob Kingwill, JP Auclair, Vincent Dorion, Justin Patnode, Jussi Oksanen, and many more travel to some of the most bizarre ski destinations on the planet. From all of the familiar places like Colorado, Canada, and Alaska to some new places like Iran and Kenya Warren Miller takes you on an unforgettable ski adventure.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Climb to Glory: Legacy of the 10th Mountain Ski Troopers (2013)
programme.desc: Climb to Glory tells the story of the 10th Mountain Division Ski Troopers and how they transformed skiing as a whole and championed the U.S. Ski In­dustry after World War II. After participating in a major turning point in the War, these heroes came back from Italy as pioneering individuals and helped expand skiing from general resort develop­ment to a lifestyle sport . Narrated by Olympian and Colorado Ski & Snowboard Museum inductee Jeremy Bloom and inspired by Warren Miller Athlete Chris Anthony, "Climb to Glory" highlights their astounding impact to our country and the ski industry.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Dynasty (2009)
programme.desc: Warren Miller’s Dynasty takes you on a breathtaking global tour of China, Alaska, Norway, Colorado, British Columbia, and more. Join legendary WME athlete Chris Anthony as he treks into China’s interior on a search for the birthplace of skiing; follow mountaineering marvel Chris Davenport to Norway’s highest peaks; reunite with the pride of the Midwestern ski community, Luke and Adam Schrab; and catch a rare glimpse at historic clips from Warren Miller Entertainment’s vault of vintage footage.

programme.title: Epic Journeys
programme.desc: Austin Ross, Chris Benchetler, and Sean Pettit join up with Jonny Moseley to track down the most amazing places to ski across the globe.

programme.title: Master of Gravity
programme.desc: Jonny Moseley explores the concept of big air, from Utah to the legendary Eiger Mountain.

programme.title: Best of the West
programme.desc: Jonny and the team explore Crested Butte, Colorado, Crystal Mountain, Washington, Steamboat Springs, Colorado and Utah.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Double Exposure (1985)
programme.desc: An adrenaline-charged ride into the world of extreme skiing, this film follows two legendary brother duos—the Egans and the DesLauriers—as they conquer towering peaks and treacherous descents. Known as ‘The Extreme Team,’ their daring pursuit of steep-slope skiing pushes the boundaries of courage, skill, and brotherhood.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Endless Winter (1995)
programme.desc: Warren Miller Entertainment is poised to kick off the 1995-96 ski season with a whirlwind tour of North America showcasing their newest film, “Endless Winter.” Miller’s cameras chased the world’s best skiers and snowboarders across four continents to create “Endless Winter.” From Alaska to Argentina and Jackson Hole to Japan, skiers and snowboarders enjoyed epic snow conditions the world over. Kurt Miller, son of the award-winning filmmaker and co-owner of Warren Miller Entertainment with partner Peter Speek, reported, “Our camera crews brought home more outstanding footage than ever before. ‘Endless Winter’ is sure to be a record-breaker!”

programme.title: Exposed
programme.desc: Jonny Moseley narrates a look at skiing right on the edge in the most exposed terrain as possible.

programme.title: Art of Flight
programme.desc: A look at pint-sized snowboarding, the US Freeskiing Open, the Points North Heli operation in Alaska, and the Winter X Games.

programme.title: Best of Colorado
programme.desc: Jonny Moseley shows four of the best places to make turns in the Colorado Rockies: Leadville, Aspen, Winter Park, and Copper Mountain.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Escape To Ski (1988)
programme.desc: For many of us the only way to find peace and relax is to break free and Escape to Ski. Watch others like yourself escape including professionals like Mike Slattery, Kate Kuchera, Scot Schmidt, Diana golden and many others to some incredible ski destinations like Maui, Morocco, Chamonix, Switzerland, and Canada. Escape now and find your freedom through skiing.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Extreme Winter (1990)
programme.desc: Winter can be long and boring but grab a pair of skis or a snowboard and transform it and find out what it’s like to have an Extreme Winter. Ride along with skiers like Tamara McKinney, Jim”Moose” Barrows, Billy Kidd, Scotty Brooksbank, and Warren Miller himself as they travel across North America all the way down to Antarctica to show you just how extreme winter can really be.

programme.title: Titans of Winter
programme.desc: This year the Warren Miller team embarked on an odyssey to the white-capped mountains of Greece with legendary mountain guide John Falkiner and two titans in the making, pro skiers Michelle Parker and Mckenna Peterson.

programme.title: BC Heli Time
programme.desc: Adaptive skiers Pete McAfee and Dom Davila head Mike Wiegele's heli-ski operation in Blue River, BC for the filming of Warren Millers Daymaker. Pete and Dom, both right-leg amputees, show there are no limits for adaptive snow sports athletes.

programme.title: Brotherhood of Skiing
programme.desc: Warren Miller's team is always on the hunt for the next generation of skiers and riders. This year a talented group of athletes, sponsored by the National Brotherhood of Skiers, traveled to Aspen, Colorado, to take part in the 49th annual NBS Summit.

programme.title: In Deep
programme.desc: An unusually strong start to the snow season in British Columbia grabbed the attention of the team at Warren Miller. The crew met up with three up-and-coming skiers: Simon Hillis, Madison Ostergren, and Marcus Goguen to see if they had what it takes - to take on these truly epic conditions. The Monashee mountains in British Columbia provided goods for this incredible snowcat adventure.

programme.title: AK Heights
programme.desc: With unmatched terrain and jaw-dropping lines, Haines, Alaska continues to be the ultimate proving ground for big mountain skiing and riding. Top athletes in winter sports and the filmmakers who capture them put this remote outpost back on the map.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Face of Winter (2018)
programme.desc: If winter puts a smile on your face, it’s something you had in common with the late, great Warren Miller. The warm, witty, mildly eccentric godfather of the ski-and-ride film was the man who got us started on this long, crazy ride. This fall, don’t miss Volkswagen presents Warren Miller’s Face of Winter, the 69th installment from Warren Miller Entertainment. Visit some of Warren’s favorite locations, from Engleberg to Chamonix, British Columbia to Alaska, Chile, Iceland, New Zealand, Washington and more. Watch world-class skiers like Jessie Diggins, along with the U.S. Nordic Ski Team as they train like champions, and catch big mountain athletes like Anna Segal, Dash Longe, Forrest Jillson, Amie Engerbretson, Seth Wescott, Jim Ryan, Marcus Caston and others as they carve down the faces of remote mountain ranges in pursuit of a life lived in high places.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Fifty (1999)
programme.desc: Warren Millers Golden Anniversary film, FIFTY commemorates a half-century of wry wintertime wit from the Grand Master of the genre. In addition to the usual dazzling display of beyond belief action, Warren Millers fiftieth release features a refreshing fusion of some of the greatest moments ever captured on film by Millers globe trotting, award winning camera crews. From the mesmerizing opening montage to the hilarious tail crawl, FIFTY takes the viewer on a rollicking ride through a dozen exotic locations and spectacular snow covered settings. Whether its the screaming descent of a 20,000 foot volcano in Equador or the pulse quickening portrait of scenic splendor in Austria, FIFTY is a tour de force for those who long to feel the freedom of fresh tracks and witness the steeps, deeps, and leaps of fellow snowriders from around the world.

programme.title: Snowy Escapades: Warren Miller Style | Warren Miller Vault
programme.desc: It’s time to get your winter stoke on - it's the Warren Miller Half-Hour!

programme.title: Skiing Solitude with Warren Miller | Warren Miller Vault
programme.desc: It’s time to get your winter stoke on - it's the Warren Miller Half-Hour!

programme.title: Warren Miller's Flow State (2012)
programme.desc: Warren Miller’s Flow State guides viewers to the top of the world’s most striking peaks, taking you on an exhilarating journey across the globe to Norway, Austria, California, Switzerland and beyond. The powder in Japan will send you scrambling to tune-up your gear, the gravity in Telluride will have you scheduling an avalanche refresher course, and the steeps in Alaska will drive you to push a little harder during your next preseason workout. Winter is right around the corner, and it is time to enter the Flow State...where the mountain meets the mind.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Freeriders (1998)
programme.desc: “Freeriders,” embarks on its national tour from October through December and spans the globe in search of freedom. “Freeriders” captures the essence of freedom as world-class skiers and snowboarders hit the slopes in spectacular style. Warren Miller, the seventy-three year old master of cutting-edge sports films, compares “Freeriders” with “the freedom of first tracks — where your most basic instinct, your instinctive search for freedom, is finally being satisfied.” To complement all of the hard-hitting action, “Freeriders” blends extraordinary cinematography with the trademark wit of Warren Miller. Along with the refreshing voices of the film’s athletes, “Freeriders” continues to feature Warren Miller’s traditional and poignant narration that have made him a legend in the world of entertainment.

programme.title: House on Haunted Hill
programme.desc: A millionaire offers ten thousand dollars to five people if they agree to stay overnight in a large, spooky, rented house. When you consider that the millionaire is Vincent Price, and the film is directed by Schlock master William Castle, you can bet the five guests are in for a long, bumpy night. This super shocker of the century was a smash hit upon its 1959 release. For architecture buffs, the home used for the exteriors of the haunted house was actually designed by Frank Lloyd Wright and built in 1924!

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead (In Color & Restored) (Edited Version)
programme.desc: This is one of the true cult classics and one of the scariest movies of all time. The dead are walking and hunger for human flesh. A group of panicked survivors are barricaded in a deserted farmhouse while the army of flesh eating zombies hovers outside their door. This over-the-top disk includes a restored original black and white version, and a color version that will thrill the horror film fan and horrify the film purist. We've added a 5.1 surround sound mix, and bonus features including a hilarious audio commentary by Mike Nelson of Mystery Science Theater 3000.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: No suspect had emerged after the rapes and murders of ten women near Tampa, Florida in 1984. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers. When one of the killer's victims survived, the FBI was able to identify 31-year-old Bobby Joe Long as the suspect.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A loner and distrustful of authority, Claude Dallas lived off the land, poaching wildlife and selling the hides. When two game wardens confronted Dallas about his deeds, they were shot and killed. After a massive manhunt, Dallas was captured and convicted but escaped months later. On the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list, Dallas eluded agents for nearly year until the FBI tracked him down in California.

programme.desc: The solutions to the most atrocious crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Even with advanced technology, vision still remains one of the most important tools for forensic investigators. They must train their eyes to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Randolph Scott plays James Barlow, an agent from Chicago hired to bring the notorious Reno brothers to justice. But wouldnt you know it? The Reno gang includes a beautiful young woman (Mala Powers), who catches Barlows eye. This western from director Tim Whelan (The Thief of Bagdad) features cinematography by two-time Oscar winner Ray Rennahan (Gone With The Wind), while the screenplay was by noted author Horace McCoy (They Shoot Horses, Dont They?). Theres also an all-star cast, including Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Edgar Buchanan, Denver Pyle, and several other shaggy sidewinders!

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: Cowboy star Bob Steele (Valley of Hunted Men, The Trail Blazers) headlines this Poverty Row western drama. As the Colorado Kid, he's falsely arrested for murder and has to clear himself. The colorful cast includes Ernie Adams, Frank LaRue, and Horace Murphy, with direction by Sam Newfield (The Terror of Tiny Town, The Mad Monster).

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Red Ryder: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
programme.desc: Red Ryder encounters bandits trying to hold up the stagecoach carrying the owner of the Devil's Hole newspaper, Libby Brooks and her brother Gerry. Red successfully drives off the attackers but becomes embroiled in further conflict, leading to a duel that nearly claims his life.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A THRILLING TALE OF REVENGE AND REDEMPTION! Based on the story Triple Cross for Danger by the widely lauded Western author Walter J. Coburn, Fighting Fury is a thrilling take on the Western revenge drama. Portraying both a father and his son, star of silent and sound cowboy adventure films, Jack Hoxie (Trouble Busters, Law and Lawless) exudes the classic American rustic charm that still defines the genre. The film spins the yarn of Clay Hill Jr. (Hoxie), a Spanish-American boy raised by a Mexican servant who vows bloody vengeance on three malicious ranchers after they murder his parents and turn his life upside down. Featuring fine supporting performances from genre heavies Helen Holmes, Buck Conners and Western mainstay Fred Kohler.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Ablaze with guns and guts and glory! Randolph Scott headlines as a star studded cast in this yarn about battling homesteaders. Director Edwin L. Marin (Tall in the Saddle) spins this dramatic post-Civil War tale that takes place in the legendary cow town of Abilene, Kansas, coaxing fine performances from the likes of Ann Dvorak, Edgar Buchanan, Thonda Fleming, and Lloyd Bridges. Saddle up and hang on!

programme.title: Shine on Harvest Moon
programme.desc: Jackson and his gang are cattle rustlers holed up in Jackson Hole Wyoming. Roy's partner Brower was once Jackson's partner and is now suspected of being in cahoots with him. Someone is tipping off Jackson as to the cattle's whereabouts and when Roy learns who it is he has a plan to trap Jackson and clear his partner. Starring Roy Rogers, Lynne Roberts, and Myrtle Wiseman as 'Lulu Belle. Directed by Joseph Kane.

programme.title: Days of Jesse James
programme.desc: Famed American western actor and singer Roy Rogers once again plays himself in this Jesse James tale that's a twist on the familiar formula. When he is summoned to bring Jesse to justice after the known villain is suspected of a bank robbery, Rogers soon discovers that Jesse has been framed and that the owner of the bank has robbed his own bank posing as Jesse. Fast-paced and fun, this classic Roy Rogers western directed by Joseph Kane (Dakota) features a whole host of original songs sung by the great Rogers himself.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Murder among ranchers is the subject of this Republic Pictures drama. Starring such names as Rex Allen, Slim Pickins, and Chester Clute, this feature was directed by William Whitney. For Trivia Buffs: At one time Whitney was known as the youngest director in Hollywood, having been hired by the newly formed Republic Pictures at the tender age of 21.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: What happens when Abraham Lincoln himself comes to New Mexico to discuss a treaty with Native American chief Acoma (Ted de Corsia)? Can the hotbed of emotions be quieted by cavalry Captain Hunt (Lew Ayres)? Or will the Captains superiors insist on provoking with the native tribe? Find out what happens in this fictional tale packed with action from 1951!

programme.title: Enemy of the Law
programme.desc: Tex Ritter stars in this western drama about a man who goes undercover to befriend a convict believed to have stolen a shipment of government gold. Also starring Guy Wilkerson as Panhandle Perkins, this offering from Hollywoods Poverty Row features the usual fistfights and entertaining storyline that made these modestly budgeted features well worth watching. Songs include Teach Me To Forget and You Will Have to Pay both sung by Tex!

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Six Gun Trail
programme.desc: Legendary cowboy star Tim McCoy stars as Captain William Carson, who along with his sidekick Magpie does battle with jewel thieves. Its an actionfilled drama of the West, with plenty of blazing guns and heman adventure! There are a couple of songs, too, including Moon Over the Plains but they arent sung by Tim McCoy. He was too darned tough to sing! Also starring Nora Lane, Ben Corbet; directed by Sam Newfield.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: Bob's Playin' A Mystery Hand... He's Marked For Death By Killer Bullets As Gunfire Echoes Over The Plains! After one of his ranch hands is killed when a gang attacks his ranch, Jim Roberts joins forces with his neighbor in an effort to fight off the Bennett Cattle Co., a company looking to rob them of their land. Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as Fuzzy Q. Jones.

programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: The end of the Mexican-American War finds a brazen U.S. Calvary captain and his men taking over a Spanish land grant. Albert C. Gannaway (The Badge of Marshall Brennan) directs an all-star cast including Jim Davis (Jock Ewing of Dallas), Arleen Whelan (Young Mr. Lincoln) and Lee Van Cleef (The Good, The Bad, and the Ugly). Also, look for appearances by legendary country & western stars Marty Robbins and Faron Young.

programme.title: The Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: A mining engineer tries to solve the murders of several heirs to a valuable radium mine in this western drama from Paramount Pictures. Stars include Charles Chic Sale, and in one of his early roles, Randolph Scott. This feature, also known as Rocky Mountain Mystery, was directed by Oscar winner Charles Barton, who would go on to direct several popular television shows, including Petticoat Junction and Family Affair...

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: A love story and a search for gold in the Valley of Death! Dubbed simple, powerful and dramatic by the New York Times on the date of its release, Death Valley is indeed an elegant depiction of love and deception in the American desert during the Gold Rush. In what was to be the final film of famed silent film director Paul Powell (Polyanna), a cast of mostly unknown actors produces uniformly excellent work. Lyrical and graceful, Powells film spins the tale of a young boy who finds love and gold, only to have it stolen from him.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
programme.desc: GENE AUTRY COMES ROARING OUT OF THE SKIES...to save the forests from an outlaw lumber ring! When ex forest ranger Gene tries to interfere with a gang destroying the timberland, hes framed for cattle-poisoning and set up for a murder charge. Yet, he still has time to sing some great cowboy songs, including Its My Lazy Day, and Hair of Gold. This is Gene Autry in a slightly different role, with some great footage filmed at Big Bear Valley and San Bernardino National Forest.
